eyebrow: CureGRIN · NYC Pharma Day · 8 Oct 2026 · Social cut
title: Bruce Leuchter:
headline: A drug company CEO explains in plain words why his company chose GRIN disorders: no treatment exists, and the cause is known.
story: There is no treatment made for GRIN disorders today. Bruce says that unmet need is the first reason his company chose them.
The layer under it: GRIN disorders have a known genetic cause, so they can go after the biology itself. It fit how they think about making medicine.
He has spent time with the families, caregivers and doctors. What is different now: they can target the disease itself, and these patients desperately need that.
